violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT THE CHEMICAL DISH WASHING MACHINE MUST HAVE A PPM OF 50 TO BE PROPERLY WORKING. PIC CALLED A TECHNICIAN DURING IN THE INSPECTION AND HAD EMPLOYEE SET UP THE 3 VAT SINK TO USE UNTIL THE DISH MACHINE IS FIXED.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Cooked pasta (60F), cooked meat in tomato sauce (60F), ravioli (60F) in the 2DWR Stacked cooler on the prep line was temping improperly. Shredded lettuce (47F), sliced tomatoes (48F), shredded cheese (51F), sliced cheese (48F), cooked chicken wing (46F), and cooked rigatoni in tomato sauce (47F) in the 2DR prep top on cookline were all improperly temping. A mozzarella cheese block (47F) and diced tomatoes (47F) in the walk-in refrigerator #2 were not temping properly. Cut romaine lettuce (50F), arugula salad mix (50F), diced tomatoes (50F) and blue cheese crumbles (50F) in the 3DR prep top for salads were not temping properly.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL COLD FOOD MUST TEMP AT 41F OR BELOW AT ALL TIMES. PIC REASSURED EHS THAT ALL FOOD HAD BEEN MOVED FROM THE TWO ADDITIONAL WALK-IN REFRIGERATORS 3 HOURS PRIOR, RIGHT BEFORE OPENING TO THE PREP TOP UNITS AND WALK-IN #2. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE MOVE ALL FOODS TO THE WALK-IN FREEZER TO RAPIDLY COOL TO 41F IN ORDER TO KEEP FOOD AND NOT DISCARDED IT IN 1 HOUR. PIC IS TO THROW AWAY ANY FOODS THAT DO NOT HIT THE 41F TEMPERATURE REQUIREMENT AFTER THE ONE HOUR ALLOWED FOR COOLING.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Cutting Board, When to Resurface or Discard
violations.observation: The cutting board(s) located in the dish area are heavily scratched and scored. The food contact surface is no longer easily cleaned and sanitized due to condition.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces such as cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. PLEASE REPLACE ALL PLASTIC CUTTING BOARDS BY TIME OF NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2DWR Stacked prep top on cookline (60F), 2DR Prep top on cookline (50F), Walk-in refrigerator #2 (51F) and the 3DR prep top unit for salads (51F), were all not working properly at time time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL FOOD ITEMS FROM THE BROKEN UNITS MUST BE MOVED TO ONE OF THE OTHER TWO WALK- IN REFRIGERATORS THAT ARE WORKING PROPERLY. PIC HAD EMPLOYEES MOVE ALL FOOD AND CALLED A TECHNICAL TO SERVICE THE UNITS SOON. A FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION WILL OCCUR TO MAKE SURE UNITS ARE FIXED AND WORKING PROPERLY.

violations.title: Slash-Resistant Glove Use
violations.observation: Single-use gloves worn during multi-tasked food preparation. EMPLOYEE LAID RAW CHICKEN ON GRILL THEN PROCEEDED TO NOT CHANGE THEIR GLOVES AND OPENED THE WALK-IN(1) DOOR.
violations.corrective_action: If used, single-use gloves shall be used for only ONE task and used for no other purposes. The single-use gloves shall be discarded when damaged or soiled or when interruptions occur in the operation. EHS POINTED OUT IMPROPER USE OF GLOVES TO PIC. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE WAS HANDS AND CHANGE THEIR GLOVES. THEN PIC HAD EMPLOYEE WASH, RINSE AND SANITIZED THE HANDLE TO WALK-IN(1).
